subject: english
question:
Select the incorrectly spelt word from the given sentence.

She was one of the wealthiest women in the world and certainly the most ecentric noble of her time.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"ecentric"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"eccentric"** which means** unconventional and slightly strange.** (असामान्य)

 
 
• **Example: **Her **eccentric **behavior made her the talk of the town.
 
 
 
• The correct word is **"eccentric"**. (असामान्य)
 
 
• **Example: **He dressed in a very eccentric manner, wearing bright colors and unusual patterns.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Noble** (कुलीन): Having or showing fine personal qualities or high moral principles.

 
 
• **Example:** He was a noble man who always put others before himself.
 
 
 
• **Certainly** (निश्चित रूप से): Used to emphasize the speaker's belief that what they are saying is true.
 
 
• **Example:** She will certainly win the competition.
 
 
 
• **Wealthiest** (सबसे धनी): Having an abundance of valuable possessions or money.
 
 
• **Example:** He is one of the wealthiest businessmen in the country.
